description: An actual quantifier-free ground formula is true in a structure exactly when its propositional skeleton is true under the structure's actual atomic truth valuation.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.skeleton_truth.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} (A : L.Sentence)
  (hA : FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.IsQF A) (M : Type w) [L.Structure M] :
  M ⊨ A ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.eval
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.truthValuation M)
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.skeleton A) =
      true
